name: Gatefold
summary: A wedding invitation whose carved doors swing open, with a live countdown, three events and a working RSVP
about: A full wedding invitation page under swaying marigold garlands. The gold seal splits, two carved maroon doors swing open in 3D and the names settle onto the card beside a ticking countdown, while petals drift past your pointer. Below sit the three evenings, an RSVP form that checks every answer and flips into a stamped reply card with a calendar file, a venue map with a dropping pin, and a maker that puts your own names and date in a shareable link.
how: Open the page: the garlands drop in, the seal splits and the doors swing open onto the names and countdown.
Move your pointer over the card to tilt it and push the falling petals aside.
Scroll to the three celebrations, then fill in the RSVP form; mistakes are explained next to each field.
Send the reply: the form flips into a stamped reply card with an Add to calendar button.
In Make your own, type the names, date, time and venue; the whole page updates as you type.
Press Copy link and send it to your guests; it opens on the sealed card.
